Commentary.Commentary: The visitors though started well, kept the run rate under some control initially which kept them in the game till the middle overs. Kuldeep Yadav was the star once again as he took three but even he went for runs along with the other bowlers. Yuzvendra Chahal was the most economical one and he picked up one as well. Hardik Pandya and Umesh Yadav too added their names to the wickets column but the death bowling looked ordinary as they conceded 94 runs in the last 10 overs. This pitch is a touch slower, however, if one stays in the middle long enough, they will score runs as shown by Joe Root. The run chase starts after a short while. See you on the other side of the break.

What a performance this has been from England. Once the opening partnership of 69 runs between Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow set up the innings, Joe Root carried it all the way. First he got together with Eoin Morgan for a century stand and then came the blazing one in which he made 83 with David Willey. The left-hander did the bulk of the hitting towards the end and thrashed the Indian bowlers. Root completed his 12th ton in the process while David his maiden fifty. It was a clinical performance from the home team batters which has put the Men in Blue under pressure with a stiff target to chase.

OUT! A yorker outside off, Willey misses it and looks for the run. However, Dhoni behind the stumps has his right glove removed and therefore he is able to hit the stumps on the full. The batsmen don't cross and Willey is out on the very last ball of the match. ENGLAND FINISH ON 322/7!

Similar ball this from Kaul, Willey plays it to mid on this time. Rohit there rushes in but even he can't stop the brace. Brilliant running from the English pair. They are pushing the Indian fielders and reaping the rewards as well. This brings up the fifty for David Willey too. What a knock this has been from the left-hander. His first one in this format.
Driven straight down the ground by Willey. Virat gets to the ball quickly and releases it but couldn't stop them from taking two.
Almost a yorker this. Root pushes it to mid off and runs a quick single.
Root moves across but Kaul follows him with a slower length ball. Root cuts it through backward point and takes two.
Siddarth Kaul to bowl the last over of the innings.
Full around off, driven through covers for a single.
Full around off, Root drives it straight to Kohli at covers and sets off for the run. Virat has a shy at the bowler's end but misses the stumps and as a result, another run is taken from the deep.
No ball! A yorker dug out to mid-wicket by Willey. A run taken, however, the umpire signals a no ball for overstepping. A Free Hit coming up...
Root gets innovative with the reverse paddle but doesn't get it cleanly. The ball lobs in the air and drops adjacent to the pitch. One run taken.
Root goes after this one but misses the line completely. It is too wide of his reach. Root looks at the umpire for the wide but doesn't get it.
Yorker from Umesh. Willey does well to dig it out. Root from the other end calls for a run and they scamper for one.
Full in line of the stumps, Root drives it through mid off and changes strike.
Wide! Root goes after this one but misses the line completely. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Full toss on middle and leg, pushed to long off for a single.

SIX! BANG! Long levers of Root comes to the fore. A full ball on off, Root lines it up and hits through the line. He has put a lot of power into it and as a result, the ball goes over the mid-wicket fence, which seems to be the longest one here.
Slower ball on off, pulled to mid-wicket for a single.

He has done it! Root gets to his 12th ton. He gets a length ball outside off, he moves across and whips it through mid-wicket for the single he needed. What a gem of an innings he has played here at Lord's. When his team was in dire need of someone to hold it all together, he stepped up. He struggled, but he's held on. Tremendous effort.
Full around off, driven to covers for nothing.
Looks to slog this one as well but can't get it cleanly off the bat this time. One run results from the long on region.

FOUR! What batting from Willey. He is making life difficult for the Indian bowlers. A back of a length ball on leg, Willey swivels and pulls the trigger. The ball goes behind the square leg and a boundary results.
Hardik Pandya comes back into the attack.
And one more full toss from Umesh. Luckily for him Willey only manages to get it to long on for a single. 11 off this one. England on the surge!

FOUR! Boom! Willey into fourth gear all of a sudden. A length ball on middle and leg, Willey lofts it over the mid-wicket fence and earns the second boundary of the over. 50-run stand comes up with this shot.
FOUR! Brute force from Willey. Another full toss on off, Willey swings his bat and gets it past the mid off fielder. A boundary results.
Yorker! Willey can't do much about that other than digging it out back to the bowler.
On the pads, on a back of a length, Root clips it through mid-wicket and moves to 99 with the single.
A low full toss on the pads, Willey punches it to long on for a run.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Yorker on off. Willey digs it out off the inner half of the bat. The ball goes to the fine leg region. One run off this one and 17 off the over. An expensive over from Kaul.
A slower ball this on middle and off, Willey swings his bat once again but doesn't get the connection this time. Two runs taken from the long on region.
FOUR! Third short ball in a row and two of them concede 10. Willey pulls this one over mid-wicket and earns and boundary.
David goes for the pull but misses it completely.
SIX! Bang! What a beautiful pick up shot from Willey. Some power display as well. A short ball on the hips, Willey picks it up handsomely and sends it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Clean as a whistle from Willey. A full ball on off, he drives it through the long off region and collects an important boundary.
A touch short outside off, Willey punches it off the back foot for a run. Kuldeep finishes his spell with figures of 10-0-68-3.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total and Root gets to 98.
A genuine leg spinner around off, Willey goes for the wild hoick across the line but ends up getting an under edge. The ball goes past the stumps and towards fine leg region. Three runs are taken.
Once again floated on middle and off, Root pushes it to long on. Another single.
Too full, easily punched down to the long on region for another one.
A tossed up ball on middle and off, Root works it to mid-wicket and changes strike.
A full ball targeting the stumps, Root drives it down the ground. One run results.
Played to the point region by Willey. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the pads, worked to the on side for another single.
Full on middle, driven to long on for a single.
A slower one just outside off, David misses the attempted shot.
A back of a length ball in line of the stumps, Willey blocks it off the back foot.
Siddarth Kaul comes back into the attack.

FOUR! Creamed! The best way to counter the spinner. A flighted ball outside off, Root puts in a huge stride and gets to the pitch of the ball. He middles the drive and pierces the gap through covers and a boundary results.
A touch short in length, Willey punches it off the back foot and takes another single through covers.
On the pads, clipped to the on side for a single.
Flighted on middle and off, driven through long on for a single.
Rocks back and clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done by Root. A faster ball outside off, all Root has to do is show the ball its way, which he does effectively. The ball races to the third man fence as a result.
Willey has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Chahal ends with figures of 10-0-43-1. Those are good returns on a track which hasn't aided the spinners much.
Played through mid-wicket for a run.
David Willey is the next batsman in.

OUT! Terrific catch from Rohit to send Ali packing. Another one bites the dust, the leg spinner gets his first of the game. Ali's timid stay comes to an end. Chahal tosses this one around middle and off, Ali comes dancing down the track. He drags it to mid-wicket where Pandya and Sharma converge for the catch. Sharma is closer to it and he has to put in a dive to complete the catch. England losing the plot here.
Root plays a sweep shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes down the track this time and chips it to long on for a run.
Flatter outside, driven through covers for a run.
Root has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Gets on the front foot and guides it to the off side. One run taken.
FOUR! Streaky but effective. Ali slogs it again and manages to get it over the short mid-wicket fielder. A boundary results in the deep mid-wicket region.
Ali misses the sweep this time and the ball agonizingly close past the off pole.
A reverse sweep to the tossed up delivery on middle and off, the ball goes towards covers and one run results.
Ali has played that off the front foot and into the ground. One run added to the total.
Kuldeep Yadav is brought back for another spell.
On leg and Root sweeps it this time. He manages to find the gap and takes two.
Almost a catch back to Chahal here. A tossed up ball around off, Root pushes at it with an angled bat and almost hits it straight back to the bowler. Luckily for him, it bounces just in front of him.

Some intent from Root here. He is looking to up the ante. A flighted ball outside off, Root misses the slog sweep and MS whips the bails off in a jiffy. No appeal from the bowling team but the umpire still takes it upstairs. The replays shows that he was well in. Root survives.
Flatter one on off, Ali waits for it and guides it with the angled bat towards third man for a run.
Similar ball and shot but the misfield from KL at short mid-wicket allows the batsmen to take a single.
Slower one around off, pushed to the on side for nothing.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back.
Around off, punched straight to covers by Ali. A nice tight spell from Umesh.
A tad shorter on middle, Root swivels and gets it to square leg for another single.
Similar delivery from Umesh, Ali works it to mid-wicket and runs a single.
No room for Ali to work with. He defends this to the on side.
On a length, kept out by Ali.
Fullish outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
Gets it to mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat. One run taken.
On a length in line of the stumps, defended by Ali.
Chipped to mid-wicket for a single.

Brilliant effort from Raina this time. Saves a certain boundary here. A loose ball outside off, Root's eyes light up as he cuts it to point. However, Raina there dives and stops the ball in its stride. The Indians have saved some 10-12 runs in the last couple of overs.
Fullish around off, driven to mid on for nothing.
On the hips, clipped to square leg for two.
Ali defends it from within the crease.
On a back of a length around off, guided to third man by Joe. One run taken.
On leg, pushed to short mid-wicket for a run.
Moeen Ali walks out to bat.

OUT! Gone! The big fish is in the bag now. Umesh has done it. A back of a length ball outside off, Buttler looks to cut but only manages an edge to MSD. An easy catch for him and India rejoice as Buttler could have changed the complexion of the game in the end overs. He is a huge wicket considering his purple patch as well. Second wicket for a pacer after three from the spinner. 189/3 to 214/5, how the fortunes change!
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a brace.
Touch short around off, pushed to covers by Buttler.
Ends the over with a length ball on off, Root happy to block it.
Full on middle and leg, driven to mid on for another single.
Waits for this one and guides it to third man for another run.
Fullish on off, Jos drags it to mid-wicket for a single.
On the hips, flicked to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Timed beautifully! A back of a length ball around off, Root cuts it through point and finds the gap. A boundary results.
Driven to mid on for no run. Buttler couldn't beat the fielder.
Goes down the ground this time, through mid on, and takes a run.
Root can't seem to catch a break. First Kohli, now Rahul. He pulls this back of a length delivery towards mid-wicket where KL dives to his right and stops it.
Stop! Good effort. Full outside off, Root drives it hard to the covers. Kohli reacts quickly, dives and saves vital runs for his side.
Stays back and offers a firm punch with a straight blade.
Good length delivery on the stumps, punched back to the bowler. Umesh deflects the ball onto the stumps but Buttler makes it back inside in time.
Umesh Yadav back on.
Short of a length outside off, punched in front of covers to end what has been a terrific over from Hardik Pandya.
Jos Buttler strides out to bat.

OUT! Edged and taken! Stokes fails to make an impact. Hardik with a lovely delivery to dismiss the big all-rounder. Lands it on a length around off, it moves away late and just enough. Forces Stokes to have a tame poke at it from inside the line and the edge is drawn. It goes behind and it's a regulation take for the former Indian skipper behind the stumps.
Full this time, sliding in, catches Root on the pads after taking the inside edge. Rolls away to third man and a single is taken.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and taps it away on the off side for one.
Short of a good length outside off, Root gets on top of the bounce and punches it through to sweeper cover. Single results.
Angling in on a good length, keeping a bit low, Root hangs his bat out to it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. It rolls away on the off side. No run taken.
Drinks break!
Outside off, played through point easily for a single. The 200 is up for England with that.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
That's close yet again! Root living a bit of a risky life here. Flicks this fuller ball aerially just wide of a diving Hardik Pandya at short mid-wicket. Single to the scoreboard.

Agonizingly close to Dhoni. He will be feeling agitated with that. Full outside off, Root gets low to play the reverse paddle and it goes off the outer half. Dhoni moves to his right to try and take it, but it's too fast even for him. It goes all the way to the boundary line behind.
This one spins the other way, quicker and flatter on off, Stokes goes back and punches it to covers. One run taken.
The googly from Kuldeep, fuller around off, it spins in as Stokes presses forward and across to block.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Root opens the face of the bat and punches it a bit square through the off side for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. For no run though.
Rises on to his toes and keeps it out safely.
Back of a length on the stumps, Stokes works it past the bowler and takes a single.
Back of a length around off, punched off the back foot to cover.
Hardik Pandya returns.
Works it away on the leg side. End of another wonderful over from Kuldeep. Does the job for his side once more.
Outside off, played to point.
Plays this before the ball can turn to mid-wicket for nothing.
Ben Stokes walks into the middle next.

OUT! GOT 'EM! And it's that man again. Kuldeep gets the much-needed breakthrough that the Indians needed. Floated around off, Morgan looks to go across the line. Slogs it hard, connects well but there's not enough elevation on it. Flat and down Shikhar Dhawan's throat who takes a fine catch just inside the rope. Partnership of 103 comes to an end.
Punched hard through the covers and comes back for the second.

In the air for a long, long time... but safe! Morgan skips out and lofts it over mid on. It goes out in the deep, but falls well short of Chahal who was running backwards. Gets two and brings up his fifty with that. His 38th in this format. Also brings up the 100-run stand between the duo. Well played so far.
Played to the point region by the batsman. End of the over.
In the air but well short of Pandya in the deep. Tossed up, Morgan can't keep the sweep down. Over backward square leg but on the bounce to Hardik. Single taken.
Worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Tossed up on leg stump, Morgan gets low and sweeps it through square leg. Pandya out in the deep does well to run to his left and make a good stop. Two to the total.
Slower through the air and turning in, flicked to mid-wicket. Dot ball.
Quick, flat and on the stumps, punched easily to long on for a single.
Googly to finish the over. Root works it through backward square leg and keeps the strike.
Touch short around off, cut through covers for another run.
Loopy on off, Morgan blocks it off the front foot.
Too full by Kuldeep, Root drags it to long on. One run taken.
Root gets to the landmark with this. On the pads, worked through square leg by Root. He scampers back for two and completes his fifty, a much needed one as well. His 29th in this format.
Flighted ball around off, pushed back to the bowler by Joe.
On the pads, flicked though mid-wicket and one run taken.
Tossed up on middle, blocked to the off side by Root.
Flatter around off, pushed to point for nothing.
In line of the stumps, Joe keeps it out off the front foot.
On the pads, worked to the on side for a run.

SIX! Morgan goes down the ground and tonks this handsomely over the long on fence. A flighted ball on middle, he gives charge and connects it nicely. The ball flies into the crowd. England on the charge now.
Dabbed down to long off for a run.
Quicker one on the stumps, flicked square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Second of the over. Raina isn't proving to be too effective so far. Darts it well outside off, Root with an angled blade steers it past short third man and finds the fence.
Steps out of the crease and punches it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Raina needs to correct his line here. Darts it full on the pads, Morgan gets low and sweeps it fine down the leg side. Nobody out there, easy boundary for the skipper.
Quicker through the air in line of the stumps, clipped off the back foot through square leg for a single.
Loopy and dipping in, nudged to mid-wicket.
Works it away on the leg side for no run this time.
Pushes it through the cover region for one run.
Uses his feet to good effect once again, comes out of his crease and wrists it to long on. One run to the total.
Looped up again, on the leg stump line, Morgan is a bit early into the sweep and the ball goes off the pads. Falls well short of short fine leg.
Full and on the pads, Morgan sweeps it down towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
he batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Spinning in, punched off the back foot down to long on for one.

Another single. These two are rotating the strike well here. Morgan works it to square leg as Raina comes from around the wicket, gets to the other end with ease. The 150 for England is up with that as well.
Slower through the air this time, but width offered outside off, Root opens the bat face and punches it to point. Another run.
Darted full and on the stumps, Morgan jams it out down towards long on. One more taken.
Dropped short and flat outside off, Joe is on the back foot as he punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Suresh Raina brought on to roll his arm over.
Full again, pushed to mid off. Wants the run at first, but then declines immediately.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Turning in, it's picked off the pads and flicked through mid-wicket. One run easily collected.
Seeing the flight on the ball, Morgan decides to prod forward and block this one out.

The catch is taken but it won't matter. Looped up on off, Root kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Rahul out in the deep moves to his left, comes running in and takes the catch. The batsmen take a single.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball! A rare occasion when Chahal oversteps and it's a no ball as a result. Morgan works this through mid-wicket and takes a single.
Leans ahead to this tossed up ball and eases it away to long off for a single.
10 off the over. A rather poor over from Hardik. Rolls his finger outside off, Root opens the face and runs it down to third man for one run.
Hit just wide of mid off for a brisk single.
Wide! Pandya needs to get his radar right. Bowls the off cutter down the leg side, goes past Morgan and that's a wide.
Short again, with a little swivel Root pulls it through backward square leg. One run taken.

FOUR! Superb shot to bring the 50-partnership between these two. Hardik pounds it in short, outside off, Root knows what he has to do before the ball even comes to him. He plays the ramp shot, clears short third man and finds the fence with ease.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short! Wide signalled by the umpire.
Advances down the wicket and slaps this length delivery around off through covers. Keeps moving ahead and gets to the other end.
Length delivery skidding off the surface, on middle and leg, Morgan is a bit hurried as he flicks this to short mid-wicket.
Plays with the spin and turns it towards the square leg area. Single to end the over.
Similar ball, similar shot, this time towards mid on where the fielder makes a sliding stop. Single taken.
A touch short, quicker through the air, Root is deep inside the crease as he punches it back to the leggie.
Makes good use of the feet. Dances down quickly, gets close to the pitch and drives it to long on for one run.
Full toss on the stumps, Root whips it away to Dhawan at deep mid-wicket for one run.
Loopy leg break full in length, on off, pushed back to the bowler off the front foot.
Banged in short but it's not as short as Morgan expected it to. He rises and swivels for the pull but takes a blow on the elbow.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Plays it comfortably enough through the covers for a single.
Fraction straight in line, easy enough for Joe to move inside the line and clip it through mid-wicket for one.
Just ahead of a length, outside off, driven firmly through the covers for a run.
Angling back in on a fuller length, Root flicks it away through the vacant mid-wicket area for a single.

Chahal throws the googly out and almost gets Morgan. He'll feel unfortunate it pitched just outside leg. It spins away towards off from leg and catches Morgan on the pads by surprise. The English skipper is a lucky man.
Good flight on this from Chahal, keeps it around off, Morgan lunges forward and meets it with a straight blade.
Root eases this full delivery through mid on and jogs to the other end.
Quite slow through the air, on middle and off, Root has to reach out a bit to defend as Chahal drags his length back just a touch.
Drifting in on the pads, easy enough for Root to clip it fine down the leg side. Gets an easy two for it.
Tossed up on off stump, Root presses forward and blocks.
Short around off, pulled to square leg by Root for a run. A good tight over from Pandya.
On a length in line of the stumps, Root drives it to mid on.
On off, blocked down the track by Joe.
A touch fuller around off, Morgan guides it to short third man and runs a quick single.
Hangs back and keeps the length ball out to the off side.
Pulls the shortish ball to square leg. One run taken.
Hardik Pandya is back on.
Defended off the front foot by Morgan presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated on middle, Morgan happy to defend.
A tad shorter from Chahal, Root gets back and pushes it through covers for a run.
Flatter on off, Root blocks it off the front foot.
In line of the stumps, pushed to mid-wicket by Joe.
Tossed up around leg, played towards fine leg for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal comes back into the attack.
Gets behind the line and defends the straightish ball down the track.
Driven through mid-on by Eoin. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on middle again, Morgan chips it uppishly through covers and scampers back for the second.

FOUR! Sweeps and sweeps hard. Another loopy delivery from Kuldeep on middle, Morgan lines it up and slog sweep it across the line. Kaul at deep square leg run to his right but couldn't stop it inside the fence.
Flighted outside off, pushed through the off side for a single.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, timed through covers by Root for a boundary. 3 fours in 3 balls for England.
FOUR! Shot. Authority this time from Morgan. A back of a length ball on hips, Morgan flicks it through square leg and picks up another boundary.

FOUR! Inside edge and misses the stumps. Lucky break for England captain. A nice pacy delivery from the pony tail man. He hurried Morgan into the shot who gets his angled bat down in line of the ball and picks a boundary.
On a length around off, defended by Morgan to the off side.
Guided to third man for a run by Joe.
FOUR! Errs in line this time and serves a losener on the pads. Root flicks it through mid-wicket and picks up a boundary.
On the pads by Umesh, Root works it to mid-wicket for nothing.
Tossed up around off, kept out off the front foot by Morgan.
Root flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Almost another here. A loopy leg break around off, Morgan comes forward to block it and manages to get an inside edge on to it. One run results from the square leg region.
Eoin has driven that ball straight back.
Flighted on off, driven to covers by Morgan.
Eoin Morgan is the next batsman in.
Drinks are on the field!

OUT! Once again, Kuldeep dismisses both the English openers. Much like the last game, he's created problems for the hosts. How ironic is this though? Roy manages to middle a slog sweep off Kuldeep Yadav's delivery but still gets out. He makes pretty sweet connection but finds the other Yadav at the mid-wicket fence who holds on to the catch and stays inside the fence. Kuldeep has another to his name and England are in a bit of trouble here.
In line of the stumps, kept out by Root.
Shortish on the pads, Root looks to guide it fine but doesn't get the connection. The ball rolls towards fine leg and a brace results.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for two.
Good effort from the Indian skipper, saved a certain boundary there. Roy drives the fuller ball to covers and almost finds the gap. One run results.
Similar delivery from Umesh, Roy happy to defend it.
Back of a length on off, cut to point.
Root has played it to the point region for nothing.
Loopy on middle, pushed to mid-wicket.
Pushed to the cover region by Roy. They look for a second but the fielder in the deep does well to attack the ball and stop the batsmen in their stride. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Slow and short and asking to be hit. Roy gets back and slaps it through covers and gets a rare boundary off Kuldeep's bowling.
Around off this time, Root pushes at it and gets it to third man for a run.
Tossed up googly around middle and leg, Roy plays it to mid-wicket and runs for a single.
Drives the length ball to long on for a run.
Fuller around off, Root drives it to mid off where Rohit puts in the dive and keeps them down to a single.
On the hips, worked to the leg side for nothing.
Hangs back and keeps it out.
Played to the point region by Roy. One run added to the total.
On a back of a length around off, Roy misses the cut as the ball goes in to the gloves of MSD.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Another shortish delivery around middle and leg, Root moves back and blocks it down the track. End of a successful over for India and Kuldeep Yadav.
On middle and leg, kept out by Root.
Defended off the front foot by Roy presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total.
Touch short on middle, Root gets back and gets it to the on side for a run.

OUT! Gone! Impact straightaway. Kuldeep Yadav working his magic yet again and is into the wickets column without wasting any time. A bit of an unfortunate dismissal for the opener though. A wrong 'un around leg, Bairstow looks to sweep but the ball hits him on his pad first and then his glove guides it to his leg stump. Bairstow is out on 38 for the second time in two matches. Also, Joe Root is the next batsman in.
Little bit of turn on the very first ball. Flighted around off, it pitches and turns back in sharply. Jonny does well to block it off the back foot.
Powerplay 2 signaled by the umpire. Maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the infield. Also,  Chinaman Kuldeep Yadav has been brought into the attack.
Around off, cut to gully for nothing. 69 runs came in the first 10 for England.
FOUR! A rare loose ball from Kaul. A full toss on the pads, Roy clips it and beats the man for a boundary through square leg.
Short on off, blocked back to the bowler by Roy.
In line of the stumps, pushed to the on side for a run.
FOUR! Another slower ball from Kaul, Bairstow drags this one across and gets it up and over to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary. He is looking to go after Kaul it seems.
Slow and full, JB goes across the line but misses.
Jonny gets back and slaps it through the off side for a run. Just 4 off his first over.
Around middle and off, driven through long off for a single.
Good bowling from Chahal. A wrong 'un this. Roy comes down the track but misses the line. Luckily for him he gets hit on the pad.
Slower through the air this time, Roy defends it off the front foot.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for another run.
Flighted around off, driven to mid off for a run.
Spin time! Yuzvendra Chahal comes on for a bowl.
Another slower ball on middle, Roy flicks it aerially and gets in the gap between mid-wicket. Dhawan there does well to get to the ball and stop them only for a single.
Good, good bowling from Kaul. Roy moves across his stumps but Kaul follows him. In the end, all Roy could do is defend it back to the bowler.
Guides it through point and runs a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Uppish... but safe! 50-run partnership comes up with this boundary as well. A good ball from Kaul, almost deceived Roy with the knuckle ball. Roy, however, goes through with the drive and manages to beat the fielder at short cover. A boundary results.
Around off, on a length, Roy taps it to gully.
Pushes this one to mid-wicket where Chahal puts in the dive and saves a couple for his team. One run taken and 17 conceded by Pandya in his second over.
Bairstow works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Slap! This is a proper slap from Bairstow. He gets a length ball on off and he punches it through covers for another boundary. 15 off 4 already.
FOUR! Width on offer and Bairstow says thank you! He cuts it up and over the infield and gets it to backward point boundary.
Punched off the back foot by Roy. They pick up a single.
SIX! The power of Roy! A mishit carrying all the way to the fence. Around off from Pandya, Roy goes through with the lofted cover drive and gets a good connection to clear the fence.
On off, driven to mid off for nothing.

Another full ball coming in with the angle. Roy misses the flick and gets hit on the pad. The bowler appeals but the umpire ignores it. Kohli has a long distance conversation with Dhoni who suggests that it might be outside off. The replays tells the same story. In the end, one leg bye stolen.
Fuller outside off, stays a tad low as Roy gets it to the off side off the bottom half of the bat.
Roy shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Saved a couple there Pandya. A length ball outside off, Bairstow cuts it and puts it in the gap. Pandya at short third man gets his right hand out just in time and stops the ball in his stride. Single taken.
A back of a length ball on middle, Roy pushes it through mid-wicket. The slope on that side allows the batsmen take three.
A play and a miss from Jonny to the ball around off. A nice first over from Hardik.

Clever change-up from Pandya. A slower ball in line of the stumps, Bairstow is early into his shot but still manages to get it safely over mid-wicket. Chahal hares after it but can't stop the batsmen from taking two.
Cut hard towards short third man for no run.
Straightish on middle, Roy dabs it to mid-wicket and changes strike.
Another shortish ball just outside the off pole, the ball moves away just a touch and whizzes past the bat of Roy.
Short of a length around off, pushed through cover-point for a single.
Hardik Pandya is on.
Full around off, slapped through mid-wicket for a run. Good over this from Kaul.
Jonny looks to hoick it across the line but doesn't get the connection.
On a length on off, played to mid on by JB.
Comes in from a length, Roy is hit on the inside half of the bat. They take a run as the ball drops adjacent to the stumps.
Fuller around middle and leg, punched to mid on by Roy.
On a short of a length outside off, pushed to covers.
Width on offer, Bairstow throws his bat at it and gets it to third man. The batsmen scamper for two.
Flicked to short mid-wicket for nothing.
SIX! Short and punished this time. Perfect height for him to pull the ball. Umesh gets a touch too straight on the hips and Bairstow makes him pay with a maximum over square leg.
Oooh! Just missed the top of off stump by a whisker. Bairstow goes across the line to play the back of a length ball but misses it. Close call!
On a length around off, JB punches it to the off side.
Outside off, Roy slashes at it and gets it up and over to third man for a run.
Short and wide, cut straight to gully for nothing. 8 off the second over.
Slaps this one to KL at covers.
FOUR! Effortless from Bairstow, this. A full ball around off, he plays through the line and the ball races behind the bowler for another boundary.
That ball has taken the inside edge of Bairstow and thudded into his pads.
FOUR! Some width on this one outside off, JB slaps it through covers. A misfield there allows the ball to race away to the boundary. He also gets off the mark with a boundary.
Full and wide, left alone by Jonny.
Siddarth Kaul to share the attack.
Driven to covers and a nice save by the fielder there. Exciting first over, this.
Jagging back in from a length, it struck Roy on his pad.
Roy has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

And almost a wicket here. A back of a length ball around off, Roy pushes at it from his crease and gets an edge on the ball. Luckily for him, the ball drops just in front of MSD behind the stumps. Good come back from Yadav.
On a length in line of the stumps, driven to Rohit at mid on for nothing.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark. Umesh errs in line on the very first ball and dishes this one on the pads. Roy clips it through square leg and earns a boundary.
And we're all set. The players are making their way out to the middle. Jonny Bairstow and Jason Roy will open the innings for England. Umesh Yadav will take the new cherry for India. Here we go...

Virat Kohli says they anyway wanted to bowl first. Feels it's a hard surface and wants to make the most of the conditions. States they have done well chasing during the T20I series, so doesn't mind doing that again. Mentions that his two spinners will be crucial in the middle overs, but the new ball will play its part as well. Adds the World Cup is quite far away, so just wants to focus on the game at hand. Says Lord's is a beautiful place to play cricket and is looking forward to it. Informs that they too are unchanged.

Eoin Morgan reckons it's going to be a belter today, so wants to put runs on the board first up. Feels the more they face India, the better they will be able to prepare against them. Is sure if he and his players stick to their strengths, they can only get better. Ends by saying that they are playing the same team.
TOSS - England win the toss and they will have a bat first!

The support has been immaculate throughout the tour for both the teams and Virat Kohli recognized the same in the last game as well. Eoin Morgan has a few things to think about coming into this contest. However, everything aside, the two top-ranked teams are a privilege to watch. The action starts soon at the Mecca of Cricket, hang around!

Hello and welcome to the second ODI between England and India at Lord's. It's a bright and sunny morning in the capital city and we're looking forward to an exciting contest between two talented sides. India are on the verge of winning the series and conquering the number one spot in ODIs from the home team as well, if they win this game. On the other hand, the English team will be looking to make amends from the last game and come back stronger against the team from Asia.
